record.scope_note: A sector-wide rule: the State Board of Education requires the board of trustees of every Florida College System institution to adopt AI policies covering set areas. Included because it binds all of the state's public colleges, not a single institution.

verification.note: Stored from flrules.org (the Florida Administrative Code and Register site of the Florida Department of State, listed as official for Florida): the rule page for 6A-14.0719, with the rule title, the State Board of Education as the issuing division, the effective date (20 Oct 2026), the reference to Training and Employment Notice 07-25 and the notice history (development, proposed and final notices, no notice of change); the final notice 31445186, with the rule file date (30 Sep 2026) and effective date (20 Oct 2026); and the Florida Administrative Register issue of 25 Aug 2026 with the notice of proposed rule, the full proposed text and the 16 Sep 2026 hearing. Also stored the Department of Education press release of 16 Sep 2026 (fldoe.org, listed as official), which says the State Board adopted binding AI rules for school districts, charter school boards and Florida College System institutions that day; it does not name the rule numbers. The adopted rule text was also stored from flrules.org as a Word .doc file, but the text layer has no reader for .doc files, so the summary follows the proposed text, which the rule page shows was adopted without a notice of change.

judgment.status_reasoning: The final notice 31445186 gives rule file date 9/30/2026 and rule effective date 10/20/2026; the rule page shows 'Effective Date: 10/20/2026' and 'History-New 10-20-26'. Today is 15 Oct 2026, five days before the effective date, so the rule is adopted but not yet in force. date_published stays the rule file date (30 Sep 2026), the date the official rule record gives for the adopted rule; the Board's vote at the 16 Sep 2026 hearing is in notes. The status should become In force after 20 Oct 2026.
judgment.scope_reasoning: An AI-specific binding rule that the State Board of Education sets for the boards of trustees of every Florida College System institution. The precedent of 15 Oct 2026 in pipeline/scope-decisions.md (institutions and sector-wide rules) puts rules a government body sets for a whole sector in, with a scope_note, and gives a state board's regulation binding all public universities as an example; this rule is the college-sector equivalent. AGENTS.md section 10 would put AI-specific sub-national implementing regulations in with no note; I followed the newer, more specific precedent.

changes.scope_note: Added under the precedent of 15 Oct 2026 on institutions and sector-wide rules, which names a state board's regulation binding all public universities as in with a scope_note; the same applies to a State Board of Education rule binding all Florida College System institutions.
